clauses.reason: Superseded by amendment: EO 12227 amends sections 1(b) and 1(c) of EO 11896 'to read as follows' with an entirely new paragraph (b), replacing the paragraph EO 12150 inserted. Actor EO 12227; no stated effective date, so effective on signing 1980-07-22.

research_rationale:
EO 12150 (signed July 23, 1979; 44 FR 43455), read in full in the held FR text, has one operative sentence: Section 1(b) of EO 11896 (Jan. 13, 1976, establishing the U.S. Sinai Support Mission; I read its sec. 1 in the held text jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_11896.txt) 'is hereby amended to read' a new paragraph (b) that redefines the Mission's duties by reference to the 1975 Basic Agreement 'as superseded by the Treaty of Peace' of March 26, 1979 and Article VII of the Appendix to Annex I. EO 12227 (signed July 22, 1980; 45 FR 49237), read in full from the held actor text, states that 'Sections 1(b) and 1(c) of Executive Order No. 11896 ..., as amended, are hereby further amended to read as follows' and prints an entirely new paragraph (b) (the Mission 'assist[s] in the implementation of the provisions of Annex I and the Appendix to Annex I' of the Treaty by verification tasks). The text inserted by EO 12150 therefore ceased to exist in EO 11896 when EO 12227 took effect; the OFR catalog confirms both as amendments of EO 11896. EO 12227 states no effective date and has no savings or transition clause, so it took effect on signing, 1980-07-22. Later events (EO 12357 of Apr. 6, 1982 adding wind-down sec. 2(g); EO 12553 of Feb. 25, 1986 revoking EO 11896 and its amendments) post-date the first end and are not used. Searches: OFR catalog 'Amended by' list for EO 11896 (EO 12150, 12227, 12357) shows no amendment of (b) between 1979-07-23 and 1980-07-22; U.S. Code and eCFR citation searches have 0 hits.

savings.reason: No savings or transition clause appears in EO 12150 or EO 12227; the paragraph EO 12150 inserted was replaced in full, and the Mission's continued existence rests on EO 11896 and EO 12227 independently. OFR catalog, U.S. Code and eCFR searches show no residual effect keyed to EO 12150.
